zh: 每个位置改或不改互不影响，所以 new 的每个字符只能变成它自己或它的循环后继（z 的后继是 a）。
这就是每个位置有两种候选字符的子序列匹配：贪心地让 old 的下一个字符尽早匹配，不会让后面的匹配变差。
对每个请求，用指针 j 指向 old；扫描 new 的每个字符 c，若 c 或 c 的后继等于 old[j] 就让 j 加一；最后 j 是否等于 old 的长度决定输出 YES 还是 NO。空的 old 一定是 YES。
en: Positions are changed independently, so each character of new can only become itself or its cyclic successor (after z comes a).
This is subsequence matching where each position offers two candidate characters; greedily matching the next character of old as early as possible never hurts later matches.

For each request keep a pointer j into old; for every character c of new, if c or its successor equals old[j], advance j. Print YES if j reaches the length of old, otherwise NO. An empty old is always YES.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan new with two pointers; if the current character or its single cyclic successor equals the next character of old, match it immediately.

## Proof of correctness

Each position independently decides whether to change. The earliest position that can match the target character can replace a later matching position in any feasible plan and leaves no fewer positions for the rest. Therefore matching each character as early as possible preserves the existence of a feasible suffix, and old is fully matched if and only if the request is feasible.

## Complexity

O(total length of all passwords) time, with O(number of requests) extra space for the output.
